meta.title: Flagged for Review
meta.statement: Nothing in this register blocks publication. It exists so every irregularity, blank and unverified assumption is visible in one place, with a source link where a source exists.

items.claim: The repository contained no content to review before this session.
items.detail: README.md was 5 bytes and the history was a single commit (d2e6358). There was no data, no site, no CI and no .gitignore.
items.resolution: All content in this repo was authored in this session and is verified against the sources listed on each row.
items.reviewer_action: Confirm nothing pre-existing was lost.

items.claim: Every number on this site is a snapshot taken 2026-11-14 and is already ageing.
items.detail: The 2026 season is in progress (Week 10). Injury designations change daily; depth charts change weekly.
items.resolution: Every page prints its capture date. Nothing is presented as live.
items.reviewer_action: Trigger a refresh before acting on anything.

items.claim: No market odds or closing lines exist anywhere in this repo.
items.detail: This environment cannot reach a licensed odds feed. Therefore there is no closing-line value, no vig-adjusted EV, no market comparison and no 'edge vs market' figure on any page.
items.resolution: The line model is line ORIGINATION only. Gate G4 is unevaluable. Recorded as Q-04 / S-05.
items.reviewer_action: Supply a licensed odds source if market comparison is required.

items.claim: Home-field advantage is set to 0.0 in the line model.
items.detail: The repo has no home/road point splits to calibrate HFA, and inventing a number from memory would violate the no-hallucination rule.
items.resolution: Published as a parameter, with its value shown on the Lines page. Every modelled line is therefore compressed toward pick'em.
items.reviewer_action: Provide a home/away scoring split source, or accept the compression.

items.claim: No injury adjustment is applied to the line model.
items.detail: The backup-deficiency index exists but has never been validated against outcomes, so applying it would be an unbacked assumption.
items.resolution: The index is published as a descriptive exposure ranking only, clearly separated from the line.
items.reviewer_action: Choose whether exposure should enter the line, once it can be tested.

items.claim: The Indianapolis Colts depth chart was not transcribed.
items.detail: 27 of the 28 teams playing in Week 10 are covered. The Colts chart was not retrieved before the build.
items.resolution: The Colts appear in the standings, schedule and injury tables but not in the backup-deficiency index.
items.reviewer_action: Fetch and add if Colts exposure matters.

items.claim: The four Week 10 bye teams (CHI, DEN, PHI, TB) are excluded from exposure analysis.
items.detail: They do not play in Week 10, so a Week 10 exposure score is meaningless for them.
items.resolution: They remain in the standings and are marked BYE on the schedule page.
items.reviewer_action: None needed unless a Week 11 view is wanted.

items.claim: 107 transcribed players carry no official game designation.
items.detail: Absence from the official report is not evidence of health - it means no designation was published at capture time.
items.resolution: Recorded as the distinct state 'no-designation-published'. Never rendered as 'healthy'.
items.reviewer_action: None; this is the honest representation.

items.claim: Replacement quality is proxied by draft pedigree and depth ordinal.
items.detail: No snap counts or player grades exist in the repo. A late-round starter who has played well is scored as a weak replacement.
items.resolution: The weighting table is published in full so it can be challenged or replaced.
items.reviewer_action: Supply snap-share data to replace the proxy (S-06).

items.claim: The shrinkage parameter k=4.0 is a modelling convention, not a sourced fact.
items.detail: It controls how hard team scoring rates are pulled toward the league mean.
items.resolution: Declared as a parameter and printed on the Lines page so it can be varied.
items.reviewer_action: Set k deliberately if a different prior is preferred.

items.claim: The strategy leaderboard is empty.
items.detail: No bets have been settled, so no strategy has a record and gate G1 cannot pass.
items.resolution: The gate machinery and reward design are published; the rows are not fabricated.
items.reviewer_action: Provide or authorise a settled-bet ledger (Q-02).

items.claim: No correlation coefficient on this site is empirically estimated.
items.detail: The engine can price a two-leg parlay with a copula, but every rho in the repo is flagged 'unverified' or an explicit independence assumption.
items.resolution: Parlays are left unpriced rather than mispriced.
items.reviewer_action: Supply per-player game logs to estimate rho (Q-07).

items.claim: Publishing model lines may carry obligations that have not been reviewed.
items.detail: The site is public. No legal review has been performed, and no odds are published.
items.resolution: A no-betting-advice disclaimer appears in the site footer.
items.reviewer_action: Legal review if this becomes more than a research dashboard (Q-13).

items.claim: Work was committed to arena/46e888f0-fl3 instead of the session-<id>/<task> convention.
items.detail: The platform pins this session to that branch and forbids creating or pushing other branches.
items.resolution: Recorded in COORDINATION.md. The pinned branch doubled as the integration branch.
items.reviewer_action: None; informational for later sessions.

items.claim: The Week 10 schedule and standings rest on one publisher (nfl.com).
items.detail: Only the Thursday result was cross-checked against a second source (ESPN). The other 13 games and all 32 standings rows have a single official source.
items.resolution: The Thursday WAS@NYG result matches on both nfl.com and the ESPN endpoint; the rest are single-sourced but official.
items.reviewer_action: Spot-check rows if desired.

items.claim: Player prop modelling was scoped out of this build.
items.detail: The brief asks for player prop bet combos. A league-wide player-stat endpoint was confirmed reachable but not ingested; no prop baselines or prop lines are published.
items.resolution: Two prop strategies (STR-05, STR-07) are registered as 'blocked-input' rather than silently omitted.
items.reviewer_action: Approve the player-stat ingest (Q-06) to unblock.
